articles.author: Reshmi Basu
articles.headline: Sleep Number Plunges 70% Ahead of a Potential Bankruptcy Filing
sourceWarnings: Texto completo restringido por suscripción. Se atribuyen al editor los preparativos y conversaciones; no se afirma que ya se hubiera presentado concurso ni cerrado financiación.
articles.summary: Bloomberg reported preparations for a potential bankruptcy filing and financing discussions, citing people familiar with the matter. These were reported preparations, not confirmation that a filing or financing had completed; only accessible article text was reviewed.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original Bloomberg Law page explicitly June 4, 2026, 2:20 PM UTC and names Bloomberg News/Reshmi Basu.

articles.author: Bay Area Telegraph Editorial Team
articles.headline: A New Store is Replacing Sleep Number in Walnut Creek
sourceWarnings: Hora o zona de publicación sin confirmar: coincidencia por fecha. Si es del mismo día, no se acredita publicación anterior a la entrada.
articles.summary: Local reporting described replacement of a former Sleep Number retail location and identified another nearby store. It does not establish a company-wide closure program. Publication clock is unknown, so same-day matching does not establish availability before the trade.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original byline explicitly June 5, 2026; article identifies the Sleep Number retail location. No publication clock.
